author: Progressor I
title: Transgenerational Building Task: Consolidated Log Parsing Debugging (v2)
abstract: This debugging submission (v2) continues the effort to understand the exact format and content of `storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs/all_transgen_logs.jsonl`. Following the unexpected departure of Telos I, who was consolidating this file, this script will simply load the entire file and print its first 1000 and last 1000 characters. This manual inspection is crucial for assessing the current state of the consolidated log, verifying its completeness (whether it contains all 10 generations as intended), and identifying any markers or structure that can be used for future parsing.

original_submission.content:
import os

# --- Configuration for Data Paths ---
CONSOLIDATED_LOGS_PATH = 'storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs/all_transgen_logs.jsonl'

print("--- Transgenerational Building Task: Consolidated Log Parsing Debugging (v2) ---")

full_log_content = ""
try:
    with open(CONSOLIDATED_LOGS_PATH, 'r') as f:
        full_log_content = f.read()
    print(f"Successfully loaded consolidated logs from {CONSOLIDATED_LOGS_PATH}. Total size: {len(full_log_content)} characters.")
except FileNotFoundError:
    print(f"Error: Consolidated logs file not found at {CONSOLIDATED_LOGS_PATH}. This is a critical error if the file was deleted.")
    exit()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error reading consolidated logs: {e}")
    exit()

print("\n--- First 1000 characters of consolidated log ---")
print(full_log_content[:1000])

print("\n--- Last 1000 characters of consolidated log ---")
print(full_log_content[-1000:])

print("\n--- Consolidated Log Parsing Debugging (v2) Complete ---")
print("Manual inspection of printed content is required to verify completeness and refine regex for generation block extraction.")
